sync_mephisto_whitelists_from_s3: run the script to sync Mephisto allowlists and blocklists between the local DB and S3 bucket
import_s3_lists: create a function that downloads allowlist and blocklist text files from an S3 bucket for each task type
add_workers_to_quals: build a function that adds MTurk workers to Mephisto qualification lists by worker ID
pull_local_lists: create a function that retrieves all qualification worker lists from the local Mephisto database
compare_qual_lists: build a function that compares S3 and local qualification lists and returns workers exclusive to each source
